channel_name: Fake cameras, batch cloning in NomixCloner.

content: We are preparing phones for Onimator. We use NomixCloner Premium to clone Instagram. When I use the single clone procedure, I have the option available to fake a camera. Since our S10 devices do not have cameras, I want this option to be enabled in the batch cloning process. Unfortunately, the example CSV does not show how to enable fake cameras in a batch cloning process. Could you give me some guidance?
